Selected MakeHuman system assets

Pack: makehuman_system_assets_cc0.zip
Author: MakeHuman community / makehuman_system
Source: https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/makehuman_system_assets.html
Download: https://files.makehumancommunity.org/asset_packs/makehuman_system_assets/makehuman_system_assets_cc0.zip
License: CC0 1.0 Universal
License text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

The official pack index explicitly lists male_casualsuit04, young_asian_male
and shoes01 as CC0. Only asset data is included; no MakeHuman application
source code is distributed here. Clothing fitting is implemented independently
from the barycentric mapping provided in each .mhclo asset.

Retained source asset bytes are unmodified. Source adaptation and rigging are
performed reproducibly by tools/art/build_rider.py.
